  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="24.5" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="60">
      <!-- Scene 1: the complaint -->
      <section id="s1" class="clip scene" data-start="0" data-duration="4.1" data-track-index="0">
        <div class="copy">
          <div class="job" id="s1-job">Puzzle 1 · Runs fast</div>
          <div class="line" id="s1-line">The owner says it gains about 40 seconds a day.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="tg-glow"></div>
        <div id="tg-hero" class="tg-case"></div>
      </section>

      <!-- Scene 2: the movement -->
      <section id="s2" class="clip scene paper" data-start="3.5" data-duration="4.9" data-track-index="1">
        <div class="frame gridded"></div>
        <div class="copy">
          <div class="title" id="s2-title">The Watchmaker's Bench</div>
          <div class="sub" id="s2-sub">Diagnose a live movement and regulate it.</div>
        </div>
        <div id="mv-hero"></div>
        <div id="mv-labels"></div>
      </section>

      <!-- Scene 3: the bench (markup follows the app's index.html) -->
      <section id="s3" class="clip scene paper" data-start="7.85" data-duration="8.75" data-track-index="2">
        <div id="bench">
          <div class="sheet">
            <aside id="rail">
              <header>
                <div>
                  <h1>The Watchmaker's Bench</h1>
                  <p class="tagline">Diagnose a live movement and regulate it, reading the timegrapher the way a watchmaker does.</p>
                </div>
                <div class="cell"><small>Calibre</small><span class="calibre" id="calibre-name"></span></div>
                <div class="cell"><small>Job</small><select id="puzzle-select" aria-label="Choose a puzzle"></select></div>
              </header>
              <div id="puzzle"></div>
            </aside>
            <main>
              <div id="movement-panel">
                <div class="tempo" id="tempo"></div>
                <div id="movement"></div>
              </div>
            </main>
            <div id="instrument">
              <div id="timegrapher" class="tg-case"></div>
              <footer>
                <label id="ctl-regulator">Regulator index <input id="regulator" type="range" min="-3" max="3" step="0.05" value="0" /><span class="value" id="regulator-value"></span></label>
                <label id="ctl-wind">State of wind <input id="wind" type="range" min="0" max="42" step="0.5" value="0" /><span class="value" id="wind-value"></span></label>
                <select id="speed" hidden aria-hidden="true"><option value="1">real time</option><option value="0.2">1/5</option><option value="0.1" selected>1/10</option><option value="0.05">1/20</option><option value="0.01">1/100</option></select>
                <button id="pause">Pause</button>
                <span id="readout-rate"></span>
              </footer>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- Scene 4: three more jobs -->
      <section id="s4" class="clip scene paper" data-start="16.05" data-duration="4.95" data-track-index="3">
        <div class="frame"></div>
        <div class="head" id="s4-head">Three more jobs on the bench</div>
        <div class="job-card" id="mini-1"><h2><small>Puzzle 2</small>Out of beat</h2><div class="tg-case"></div><div class="ctl"><span>Beat adjustment (stud)</span><span class="value"></span></div></div>
        <div class="job-card" id="mini-2"><h2><small>Puzzle 3</small>Afternoon slump</h2><div class="tg-case"></div><div class="ctl"><span>State of wind</span><span class="value"></span></div></div>
        <div class="job-card" id="mini-3"><h2><small>Puzzle 4</small>Position error</h2><div class="tg-case"></div><div class="ctl"><span>Position</span><span class="value"></span></div></div>
      </section>

      <!-- Scene 5: outro -->
      <section id="s5" class="clip scene paper" data-start="20.4" data-duration="4.1" data-track-index="4">
        <div class="frame gridded"></div>
        <div class="copy">
          <div class="title" id="s5-title">The Watchmaker's Bench</div>
          <div class="sub" id="s5-sub">Why a watch keeps bad time, and how you fix it.</div>
          <div class="url" id="s5-url">watchmakers-bench.pages.dev</div>
        </div>
        <div class="credit" id="s5-credit">Music: Sascha Ende, ende.app (CC BY 4.0)</div>
        <div id="mv-outro"></div>
      </section>

      <!-- The hand. Position is set per frame by the runtime, which follows the real slider thumb. -->
      <div id="cursor" class="clip" data-start="8.2" data-duration="3.4" data-track-index="5">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 26" width="40" height="52"><path d="M1 1 L1 20 L6 15.6 L9.4 23.6 L12.6 22.2 L9.2 14.4 L16 14.4 Z" fill="#1c2733" stroke="#fbfcf8" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </div>

      <!-- Audio: bed on 10, accents above it. -->
      <audio id="music" data-start="0" data-duration="24.5" data-track-index="10" data-volume="0.3" data-fade-in="0.4" data-fade-out="1.6" src="assets/music/vol-12-bed.mp3"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-ticks" data-start="0" data-duration="4.2" data-track-index="11" data-volume="1" src="assets/sfx/ticks.mp3"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-grab" data-start="8.72" data-duration="0.2" data-track-index="12" data-volume="0.7" src="assets/sfx/click_003.ogg"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-solved" data-start="13.11" data-duration="1.48" data-track-index="13" data-volume="0.38" src="assets/sfx/impactBell_heavy_000.ogg"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-card-1" data-start="16.9" data-duration="0.11" data-track-index="14" data-volume="0.45" src="assets/sfx/drop_001.ogg"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-card-2" data-start="17.44" data-duration="0.19" data-track-index="15" data-volume="0.45" src="assets/sfx/drop_002.ogg"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-card-3" data-start="17.99" data-duration="0.19" data-track-index="16" data-volume="0.45" src="assets/sfx/drop_003.ogg"></audio>
      <audio id="sfx-url" data-start="22.91" data-duration="0.12" data-track-index="17" data-volume="0.6" src="assets/sfx/bong_001.ogg"></audio>
    </div>
    <script>
      const render = Bench.mount();
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // The film clock. GSAP writes the frame number through a setter, so every seek redraws the
      // watch from the sim (no reliance on callbacks, which a seek may suppress).
      let frame = 0;
      const clock = { get f() { return frame; }, set f(v) { frame = v; render(v); } };
      tl.fromTo(clock, { f: 0 }, { f: Bench.FRAMES, duration: Bench.DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);

      const rise = (sel, at, y = 26, d = 0.55) => tl.fromTo(sel, { opacity: 0, y }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: d, ease: "power3.out" }, at);
      const fadeIn = (sel, at, d = 0.5) => tl.fromTo(sel, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: d, ease: "power1.inOut" }, at);

      // Scene 1
      fadeIn("#tg-hero", 0, 0.5);
      fadeIn("#s1-job", 0.15, 0.4);
      rise("#s1-line", 0.3);

      // Scene 2
      fadeIn("#s2", 3.5);
      rise("#s2-title", 3.95);
      rise("#s2-sub", 4.45);
      // beat-grid: labels on 5.45, 6.55, 7.64 (odd beats; the escapement ticks on the even ones: 4.91, 6.00, 7.09, 8.18)
      tl.fromTo("#lab-wheel", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out" }, 5.45);
      tl.fromTo("#lab-fork", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out" }, 6.55);
      tl.fromTo("#lab-balance", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.64);

      // Scene 3. beat-locked: 8.74s (cursor grabs the regulator) and 13.11s (solved); both are driven
      // by the scenario in src/scenario.ts, which the runtime renders per frame.
      fadeIn("#s3", 7.85);

      // Scene 4
      fadeIn("#s4", 16.05);
      rise("#s4-head", 16.4);
      // beat-grid: card 1 at 16.93s, card 2 at 17.47s, card 3 at 18.02s; the set then holds to 20.4s
      rise("#mini-1", 16.93, 34, 0.5);
      rise("#mini-2", 17.47, 34, 0.5);
      rise("#mini-3", 18.02, 34, 0.5);

      // Scene 5
      fadeIn("#s5", 20.4);
      rise("#s5-title", 20.75);
      rise("#s5-sub", 21.2);
      // beat-locked: 22.93s (URL lands with a tick of the escapement)
      rise("#s5-url", 22.83, 18, 0.4);
      fadeIn("#s5-credit", 23.1, 0.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
      tl.seek(0);
      render(0);
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

# Brag video

A 24.5 s launch video for The Watchmaker's Bench, made with the `/brag` skill and Hyperframes.

- `brag.mp4`: the video (1920x1080, 60 fps). Frame 0 is the poster.
- `brag.jpg`: the poster frame.
- `share-copy.txt`: one caption, postable as is.
- `brag-plan.md`, `composition-brief.md`: the plan and the handoff brief.
- `composition/`: the Hyperframes project.

The timegrapher and the movement drawing in the video are not mock-ups. `composition/src/film.ts` imports the app's sim core and renderers unchanged and draws every frame from them; `composition/src/scenario.ts` scripts what the hand does. The escapement's contact stepper is run offline into `poses.js`.

## Rebuild and re-render

From the repository root (Node 22, ffmpeg on PATH):

```sh
npm ci
node brag-output/composition/build/build.mjs   # bench.js, poses.js, rms.js
cd brag-output/composition
npm run check
npx hyperframes@0.9.44 render --fps 60 --quality delivery --output ../brag.mp4
```

If the app's `src/` changes, rebuild before rendering: the video follows the sim.

## Notes

- The instrument clock is sped up in the edit (about 18x to 33x) so the 60-second hold fits; the on-screen label still reads what the app shows ("at 10x time").
- Hyperframes substitutes Inter for the app's Avenir Next so renders are the same on every machine.
- Music: "Happy Beats / Business Moves Vol. 12" by Sascha Ende, ende.app, CC BY 4.0 (first 26 s). Credit it wherever the video is posted. Sound effects: Kenney.nl, CC0.
- Hyperframes usage telemetry was turned off on this machine for the build (`hyperframes telemetry disable`).

Summary of the project (as the video tells it)

The Watchmaker's Bench is a browser bench where you learn why a mechanical watch runs fast or slow by diagnosing and regulating a live, simulated movement through a timegrapher. The video is one repair:

  1. The complaint (0–3.8 s): dark timegrapher screen, the trace tilting, +41 s/day, a ticking watch, and puzzle 1's own line: "The owner says it gains about 40 seconds a day."
  2. The movement (3.8–8.2 s): the escapement drawing running on the drafting sheet, with the title and three labels (escape wheel, pallet fork, balance).
  3. The repair (8.2–16.4 s): the three-column bench. A cursor drags Regulator index toward S, the regulator glows ruby, the rate falls to 0, the hold bar fills to "solved", and "Why it worked" opens.
  4. Three more jobs (16.4–20.8 s): Out of beat, Afternoon slump and Position error, each on a small live timegrapher.
  5. Outro: "Why a watch keeps bad time, and how you fix it." and watchmakers-bench.pages.dev.

The timegrapher and movement are not mock-ups: the composition imports the app's sim core and renderers unchanged and draws every frame from them. "Solved" is the app's real completion rule firing.

Things you should know

  • Font: Hyperframes substituted Inter for the app's Avenir Next, so the type differs slightly from the live site.
  • Time compression: the instrument clock runs about 18–33× in the edit so the 60-second hold fits, while the on-screen label still reads "at 10× time" as the app shows it.
  • Music credit: the bed is CC BY 4.0 (Sascha Ende, ende.app). The credit is on the outro and in the share copy; keep it wherever you post.
  • Audio not auditioned: I can't listen to the mix. Levels were measured (peak −4.2 dB), but give it one listen, especially the synthesized tick bed in the first four seconds.
  • Hyperframes setup: its authoring skills aren't installed in this session, so I worked from the CLI's docs. I also turned its usage telemetry off on this machine (hyperframes telemetry disable).
  • Repo weight: the branch carries the 7.6 MB video and a 0.6 MB music clip. Nothing touches main or any agent-owned file.
